Relevant source region x71 y410 width1030 height478, Amenities heading and5chips ONLY. Input2 rough mock is secondary localized Japanese copy/layout; do not copy its inaccurate dryer/wifi vectors. Optical consistency and baseline alignment, normal thin source outline strokes, no malformed vectors.

Adapt this actual selectedstate to forest-green gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with WHITE Wi-Fi glyph and WHITE label, distinct clear border. All4unselected chips stay WHITE with fine neutral border, slate #526173 icons and ink labels. No broadmint fill, no randompurple/orange icons, no secondary selectedchip.
Purewhite #FFFFFF canvas; compact rounded white section surface, subtle border and faint downward shadow, chip-pill anatomy and2+3flow preserved. Japanese Meiryo heading Bold20/28; ALL chiplabels delicate REGULAR40014px/24px,tracking0, singleline. Do not make labelsbold. Flat frontal high-resolution landscape3:2 with modestwhite margins. reviewNotes: 5個の日本語と無線通信だけの選択状態を保持。原の黒い選択枠を森林緑グラデーションへ、非選択は白とスレート。Wi-Fi3本の弧と点、駐車・空調・テレビを視認。ただし乾燥機に原参照にない上部の横操作バーが入り細部が洗濯機に見えるため修正。所有者承認・実装ではない。
